Technical readiness.concepts: Explain a weak concept from memory and distinguish it from a similar technology.
Technical readiness.tools: Choose a tool or command and explain what evidence you expect it to return.
Technical readiness.scenario: Interpret a new troubleshooting scenario and justify the first action.
Technical readiness.pbq: Complete a relevant PBQ or lab independently and explain a tempting wrong action.

Practice performance.timed: Finish a timed rehearsal and inspect the incorrect and unanswered questions.
Practice performance.misses: Explain the evidence behind previous misses or guesses without viewing the key.
Practice performance.gaps: Resolve the main knowledge gaps identified in your review.
Practice performance.transfer: Apply the reviewed skill to a different example without help.

Exam preparation.format: Describe the official exam format, including the possibility of performance-based questions.
Exam preparation.pace: Set a realistic pace and reserve time to revisit flagged items.
Exam preparation.rules: Verify the check-in, ID and testing rules for your delivery method.
Exam preparation.booking: Verify exam code 220-1202 and your appointment details, or the intended booking if you still need to schedule.
